subject.title: [Bug]: Hallucination Loop — Agent Generated Irrelevant Multi-Thousand-Word Responses Across 2 Simultaneous Sessions

question: Should this incident be treated as expected shared-main-session configuration behavior, a Telegram/session routing bug, or a new semantic runaway-output guard requirement?
rationale: The source and diagnostics show several plausible boundaries, but choosing between config guidance, routing/session isolation, delivery replay repair, and semantic loop policy changes product behavior across messaging channels.

options.title: Investigate As Cross-Surface Incident
options.body: Keep the issue open for maintainer review and require a focused Telegram reproduction or fixture before choosing the repair boundary.

options.title: Route To Configuration Guidance
options.body: Treat the two-chat sharing as expected main dmScope behavior and update docs or support guidance only if maintainers decide no runtime bug remains.

options.title: Create A Narrow Canonical Follow-Up
options.body: Split the remaining work into a new canonical tracker once maintainers identify whether the root cause is routing, delivery replay, busy queueing, or semantic loop detection.

recommendation.title: Investigate As Cross-Surface Incident
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open for maintainer review and require a focused Telegram reproduction or fixture before choosing the repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision spans shared queue/session behavior and product policy, and the strongest history signal for those core reply paths points to steipete.
